text:
aisha: quick one — PR #1279 updates the onboarding snippet for the signet starter app but I noticed the auth example is using the old client constructor. can someone take a quick look?

matt: saw that, thanks. which file?

aisha: docs/hello-signet/getting-started.md lines ~45-60 in the PR. the snippet currently shows `RedwoodClient(api_key=..)`, but our SDK v4 uses `Client(api_key=...)` and the import changed. small but confuses new users.

james: assigning to me. i'll update the snippet and add a brief note about env var vs direct key.

aisha: thanks. also the sample app link at the end is 404 — looks like it points to the old repo path. can we patch that too?

omike: (not in thread)

matt: @james also double-check the streaming example — some folks on support said the streaming call differs between hosted and private deployments. if possible add a one-line caveat.

james: yup, i'll add a small callout: "streaming behavior may vary by deployment; see console settings" with a link.

olivia: is this urgent for the next docs deploy? we have a staging push today.

aisha: yeah prefer it in staging, but if it's tight just fix the auth snippet and link; the streaming caveat can go in a follow-up.

james: pushing a small commit now. updated import, constructor, and fixed the sample app link to https://github.com/redwood-inference/signet-starter. also added an inline note about env var usage.

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for docs repo — run #4578

docs-bot: lint check: code-snippet-style passed; link-checker found 1 redirect (now fixed by james).

matt: quick review: code looks good. one nit — prefer `export REDWOOD_API_KEY` example in unix shell instead of `set` to cover mac/linux by default.

james: updated to show both POSIX and Windows variants.

aisha: perfect. i added :eyes: and re-requested a review. thanks all.

olivia: can we add a tiny note in the quickstart TOC that mentions "Auth & SDK differences"? tiny header so it's visible in search.

aisha: good idea, low-friction. james, if you can add a TOC line i'll merge after CI.

james: done — TOC entry plus a 1-line anchor. making the PR title: "docs(signet): fix auth snippet, link, and add TOC note"

deploy-bot: staging deploy started — job 4578 in progress

docs-bot: ci: all checks passed.

matt: looks good, merging when green. :thumbsup:

james: merged and backported the snippet update to the v4 migration note. thanks!

aisha: awesome — closing the loop. can someone add a short follow-up issue to check streaming examples across Dedicated/Private? ticket would be handy for eng-ml.

matt: will open one and tag eng-ml.

aisha: thanks team! :tada:
